## Library Statements:

```{r}
library("sf")
library("terra")
library("tidyverse")
library("lubridate")
library("exactextractr")
library("rgbif")
library("RColorBrewer")
```

## Rainfall Data From 1990-2025

Loading and cleaning rainfall data.

```{r}
# List all rainfall GeoTIFFs (Change this path to where you have the data stored)
rain_base_path <- "/Users/roronorazoro/Documents/GitHub/Oahu-Rainfall-Watershed-Risk/data/oahu_rain"

all_tifs <- list.files(rain_base_path, pattern="\\.tif$", recursive=TRUE, full.names=TRUE)

# Filter years
rain_files <- all_tifs[grepl("_(199\\d|200\\d|201\\d|202[0-5])_\\d{2}\\.tif$", all_tifs)]

# Checking if files loaded in properly
if(length(rain_files) == 0){
  stop("No TIF files found for 1990-2025. Check your folder or filenames!")
}

# Stack all the files
rain_stack <- rast(rain_files)

# Name each of the layers by YYYY_MM from filename
names(rain_stack) <- gsub(".*_(\\d{4}_\\d{2})\\.tif$", "\\1", basename(rain_files))
```

Monthly and annual computations

```{r}
#m Monthly metrics
rain_metrics <- map_dfr(1:nlyr(rain_stack), function(i){
  r <- rain_stack[[i]]
  vals <- values(r)
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
  
  data.frame(
    month = names(r),
    mean_rain_mm = mean(vals),
    min_rain_mm  = min(vals),
    max_rain_mm  = max(vals),
    sd_rain_mm   = sd(vals),
    p10_rain_mm  = quantile(vals, 0.10),
    p90_rain_mm  = quantile(vals, 0.90)
  )
})
rain_metrics

# Annual means
annual_mean <- mean(rain_stack)
annual_mean
```

Annual Rainfall Map

```{r}
# Convert raster to data frame for ggplot
annual_df <- as.data.frame(annual_mean, xy=TRUE)
colnames(annual_df) <- c("x", "y", "rain_mm")

# Plot annual rainfall map
ggplot(annual_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = rain_mm)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#2E8B57", "#ADD8E6"),  # green → light blue
    name = "Rainfall (mm)",
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth = 1.5, barheight = 15,
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5
    )
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Oʻahu Average Rainfall 1990–2025",
    subtitle = "Values in millimeters (mm) per month",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

Annual Rainfall Over Time

#Look for significant events like droughts or storms

```{r}
# Annual Mean Rainfall Line Plot 1990-2025

# List of rainfall tifs
rain_base_path <- "/Users/roronorazoro/Documents/GitHub/Oahu-Rainfall-Watershed-Risk/data"

all_tifs <- list.files(rain_base_path, pattern="\\.tif$", recursive=TRUE, full.names=TRUE)

# Filter years 1990-2025
rain_files <- all_tifs[grepl("_(199\\d|200\\d|201\\d|202[0-5])_\\d{2}\\.tif$", all_tifs)]
if(length(rain_files)==0) stop("No files found!")

# 2) Load rasters
rain_stack <- rast(rain_files)
names(rain_stack) <- gsub(".*_(\\d{4}_\\d{2})\\.tif$", "\\1", basename(rain_files))

# Extract year from layer names
years <- as.integer(substr(names(rain_stack), 1, 4))
unique_years <- sort(unique(years))

# Compute annual mean rainfall
annual_means <- map_dbl(unique_years, function(y){
  layers <- rain_stack[[which(years == y)]]
  vals <- values(layers)
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
  mean(vals)
})

mean_rain_per_year <- data.frame(
  year = unique_years,
  mean_rain_mm = annual_means
)

# -------------------------------
# 4) Plot line chart
# -------------------------------
ggplot(mean_rain_per_year, aes(x=year, y=mean_rain_mm)) +
  geom_line(color="steelblue", size=1) +
  geom_point(color="darkred") +
  labs(
    title="Oʻahu Island-Wide Mean Rainfall (1990-2025)",
    x="Year",
    y="Mean Rainfall (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

## NDVI Data From 2000-2025

Loading and cleaning NDVI data

```{r}
# List all NDVI GeoTIFFs (Change this path to where you have the data stored)
ndvi_base <- "/Users/roronorazoro/Documents/GitHub/Oahu-Rainfall-Watershed-Risk/data/oahu_ndvi"

all_ndvi_tifs <- list.files(ndvi_base, pattern="\\.tif$", recursive=TRUE, full.names=TRUE)

# Filter years
ndvi_files <- all_ndvi_tifs[
  grepl("ndvi_modis_day_oa_data_map_(200\\d|201\\d|202[0-4])_\\d{2}_\\d{2}\\.tif$", all_ndvi_tifs)
]

cat("Total NDVI files detected:", length(ndvi_files), "\n")

# List files that are able to be used

valid_ndvi <- list()

for(f in ndvi_files){
  try({
    r <- rast(f)
    valid_ndvi[[length(valid_ndvi) + 1]] <- r
  }, silent = TRUE)
}

cat("Successfully loaded:", length(valid_ndvi), "NDVI rasters\n")
cat("Unreadable files:", length(ndvi_files) - length(valid_ndvi), "\n")

# List bad files for transparency
bad_files <- setdiff(ndvi_files, sapply(valid_ndvi, sources))
if(length(bad_files) > 0){
  cat("Unreadable NDVI files:\n")
  print(bad_files)
}

if(length(valid_ndvi) == 0){
  stop("No valid NDVI rasters could be loaded.")
}

# Stack useable rasters
ndvi_stack <- rast(valid_ndvi)

names(ndvi_stack) <- gsub(
  ".*_(\\d{4}_\\d{2}_\\d{2})\\.tif$", 
  "\\1",
  basename(sources(ndvi_stack))
)

# Extract date components
dates <- names(ndvi_stack)
years <- as.integer(substr(dates, 1, 4))
months <- substr(dates, 1, 7)
```

Monthly and annual computations

```{r}
# Monthly mean(2000–2025)
monthly_ids <- unique(months)

monthly_ndvi <- map_dfr(monthly_ids, function(m){
  idx <- which(months == m)
  r <- mean(ndvi_stack[[idx]])
  vals <- values(r)
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
  
  data.frame(
    month = m,
    mean_ndvi = mean(vals),
    min_ndvi  = min(vals),
    max_ndvi  = max(vals),
    sd_ndvi   = sd(vals),
    p10_ndvi  = quantile(vals, 0.10),
    p90_ndvi  = quantile(vals, 0.90)
  )
})
head(monthly_ndvi)

# Annual NDVI (2000-2025)
unique_years <- sort(unique(years))

annual_ndvi <- map_dfr(unique_years, function(y){
  idx <- which(years == y)
  r <- mean(ndvi_stack[[idx]])
  vals <- values(r)
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
  
  data.frame(
    year = y,
    mean_ndvi = mean(vals)
  )
})
annual_ndvi
```

Long-Term Mean NDVI Map

```{r}
annual_mean_raster <- mean(ndvi_stack)

annual_df <- as.data.frame(annual_mean_raster, xy=TRUE)
colnames(annual_df) <- c("x", "y", "ndvi")

ggplot(annual_df, aes(x=x, y=y, fill=ndvi)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = (brewer.pal(9,"YlGn")),
    name="NDVI",
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth = 1.5, barheight = 15,
      title.position="top",
      title.hjust=0.5
    )
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title="Oʻahu Mean NDVI (2000–2024)",
    subtitle="MODIS NDVI daily data aggregated to long-term mean",
    x="Longitude", 
    y="Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14) +
  theme(
    legend.position="right",
    plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold"),
    plot.subtitle=element_text(hjust=0.5)
  )
```

